name: jetc-profile-live
description: Tools/perf/jetc-profile/live.sh and its Jet twin jetc-profile/live/run.jet, which attach perf to a running jetc for a few seconds (frame pointers, then a fresh DWARF window when most stacks came back truncated, unless JET_CALL_GRAPH picks one) and write the profile twin's reports. Sampling needs a live process the user may signal, and no pid names one on every machine, so the cases stop at the refusals before it: no arguments and too many, a pid or seconds that is not a positive whole number (zero, a suffix, a fraction, a trailing newline), and a pid no process has, which `kill -0` refuses with its status.
